# Arturo Arias — Data and AI Portfolio

> Professional portfolio of Arturo Arias, a Data and AI professional pursuing the MISM–Business Intelligence and Data Analytics program at Carnegie Mellon University, with a background in chemical engineering. Work spans business intelligence, analytics, data engineering, machine learning, and AI automation.

The links below use the portfolio's canonical domain, https://arturoarias.me/. Dates, availability, and project results reflect the source pages. The full Markdown file includes the public page content and the JavaScript-powered project and skills catalogs; linked documents and external repositories remain separate resources.

## Portfolio overview

- [Full portfolio in Markdown](https://arturoarias.me/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive content, including experience, education, awards, certifications, projects, skills, volunteering, writing, and contact details.

- [Contact](https://arturoarias.me/#contact): Email, professional profiles, location, relocation preferences, and availability.

## Professional experience

- [Independent / Incarail — Business Intelligence Specialist](https://arturoarias.me/experience/independent1.html): BI dashboard modernization in rail and tourism, May–August 2025.
- [Auna / Oncosalud — Data Analyst](https://arturoarias.me/experience/auna.html): Healthcare reporting automation and digital analytics, November 2024–May 2025.
- [Alicorp — Researcher](https://arturoarias.me/experience/alicorp.html): Research and Python-powered nutritional analysis, May 2021–March 2024.

## Project case studies

- [Real-Time Crypto Volatility Detection](https://arturoarias.me/projects/crypto-volatility.html): Coinbase streaming data, Kafka, XGBoost, MLflow, FastAPI, and monitoring.
- [Auna / Oncosalud Web Analytics](https://arturoarias.me/projects/auna-web-analytics.html): Python reporting pipelines, AWS Athena, GA4, and Power BI.
- [Power Substation Segmentation and Build Recommendations](https://arturoarias.me/projects/substation-segmentation.html): U-Net aerial-image segmentation and MILP site optimization; academic proof of concept.
- [Power Outage Forecasting and Emergency Generator Allocation](https://arturoarias.me/projects/power-outage-forecasting.html): Michigan county-level outage forecasts and generator allocation.
- [Huambra Café Analytics Dashboard](https://arturoarias.me/projects/huambra-cafe.html): BigQuery, Cloud Run, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric for a café in Pucallpa, Peru.
- [Chess Rating Time Series Forecasting](https://arturoarias.me/projects/chess-rating-forecasting.html): Statistical analysis and ARIMA forecasting of personal chess ratings.
- [Digital Nomad City Recommender](https://arturoarias.me/projects/digital-nomad-recommender.html): Python desktop application ranking cities using visa, cost, and internet data.
- [Student Attendance Management System](https://arturoarias.me/projects/student-attendance-sql.html): Relational database design and SQL for attendance and scheduling.
- [Peru National Football Dataset](https://arturoarias.me/projects/peru-football-dataset.html): Curated national-team match records from 1927 to 2024.
- [ChemE Jeopardy Platform](https://arturoarias.me/projects/cheme-jeopardy.html): Networked educational game with moderator, player, and display interfaces.
- [EDA of International Football Results](https://arturoarias.me/projects/football-results-eda.html): Analysis of 47,399 matches spanning 1872–2024.
- [This portfolio website](https://arturoarias.me/projects/this-portfolio.html): Static portfolio, responsive design, contact backend, and AI assistant.
